final: WITH account_counts AS (SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM "order" GROUP BY account_id), total AS (SELECT SUM(order_count) AS total_count FROM account_counts), shares AS (SELECT c.order_count, CAST(c.order_count AS REAL) / t.total_count AS share FROM account_counts c CROSS JOIN total t WHERE t.total_count IS NOT NULL), average_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS value FROM shares) SELECT SUM(s.order_count), AVG(s.share), AVG(s.share - a.value) FROM shares s CROSS JOIN average_share a WHERE a.value IS NOT NULL AND s.share > a.value
